title: Elf Bar JoinOne Blueberry Sour Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry Sour Raspberry combines two of Elf Bar’s most popular fruit flavours in a perfectly balanced mix of sweet and tart. The smooth, jammy Blueberry base is lifted by a sharper Raspberry note that adds a bright, tangy twist, creating a lively fruit vape that’s satisfying and well-rounded Each JoinOne Prefilled Pod + Refill arrives ready to use with 2ml pod and 10ml refill container of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and an integrated dual-mesh coil for consistent flavour delivery. Simply assemble then slide into the Mini Battery and snap it onto the larger battery (the one with the HD Screen) adjust the kit’s airflow to suit a tighter or looser mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw. When the pod is empty, simply replace it with a fresh one — no refilling or coil changes required. This pod keeps maintenance simple while offering clean, flavour in a compact format.
